launch_rule: Launch traffic only after supply, proof, freshness, and response gates pass.
action_order: Recruit six anchor lifting suppliers with proof-first outreach.
Publish twenty-four paid listings at USD 99 per year or USD 9 per month per active machine.
Run three controlled direct enquiry drills and measure supplier response.
Review success-fee readiness only after quote, award, or booking workflow proof exists.
guardrails: Buyer pays supplier directly in phase one.
Heavyster earns listing SaaS first, not rental commission.
Do not scale paid traffic until supply, proof, and availability freshness are visible.
Keep the 1% confirmed-booking success fee as a phase-two option after workflow proof.

success_definition.market: UAE Lifting has enough verified supply to receive buyer traffic without looking empty.
success_definition.supplier: At least six rental yards have live proof-backed listings and direct enquiry routes.
success_definition.revenue: Twenty-four active listings create USD 2,376 modeled annual listing ARR.
success_definition.trust: Eighteen proof packs and twelve freshness checks make the route safe enough for serious enquiries.
